toolDefinitions.name: get_product

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios

data.summary: Synthetic headset stand analysis using demo costs and demo-direct channel rule as of 2026-10-24. Compared target revenue margins of 20%, 30%, and 40% with and without a 10% discount. Discounted cases do not retain the target revenue margin; margins fall to 12.23%, 23.35%, and 34.46% respectively.
assumptions: Product and rule are both demonstration fixtures with validFrom 2026-10-24 through 2026-10-26.
All charges use the same revenue basis in the synthetic rule: 10% channel fee, 0% tax, 0% advertising, and BRL 2 fixed fee.
Costs include material, energy, printer usage, labor, packaging, and a failure provision based on the synthetic failure rate; these are confirmed only within the demo fixture, not as business data.
limitations: Failure model assumes full-print retry for the synthetic fixture.
No marketplace verification was performed; the rule is synthetic and not Shopee.
Prices are drafts only and require human approval; no price was applied or published.

calls.arguments: {"verdict":"revise","findings":[{"evidencePointer":"/summary","issue":"The summary says the discounted cases do not retain the target revenue margin, but the draft also presents these discounted scenarios as part of the main comparison without explicitly labeling them as discounted-only outcomes or clarifying that the target margin is defined on the undiscounted recommended price.","requestedChange":"Revise the summary to explicitly distinguish target-margin pricing from post-discount realized margin, and state that discounted scenarios are a stress test of price concessions rather than target-margin-achievement cases."},{"evidencePointer":"/assumptions/0","issue":"The assumption references a validity window for the demonstration fixtures, but the objective only requires the analysis as of 2026-10-24 and does not ask for a forward-validity claim. This creates an unsupported implied availability window beyond the as-of date.","requestedChange":"Either remove the forward-validity statement or qualify it as a fixture-specific metadata field that is not a claim of business availability beyond the as-of date."},{"evidencePointer":"/scenarios/1/scenario/revenueMargin","issue":"The discounted 20% scenario is shown with a realized revenue margin of 12.23%, but the draft does not explicitly state the calculation basis for the discounted margin in the scenario entry itself, which can make the negative impact of discounting easy to misread as a target-margin miss in the underlying pricing formula.","requestedChange":"Add an explicit field or note in each discounted scenario clarifying that the displayed revenueMargin is post-discount realized margin on charged price, not the original targetRevenueMargin."},{"evidencePointer":"/limitations/2","issue":"The limitation says the rule is synthetic and not Shopee, which is valid, but the draft elsewhere names the applied rule as 'demo-direct' without a clear validity label on the scenario-level rule itself. That makes the source/validity labeling slightly inconsistent across the document.","requestedChange":"Add or harmonize a scenario-level validity label for appliedRule and ruleId so every scenario clearly states the rule is a synthetic demonstration fixture."}]}

findings.issue: The summary says the discounted cases do not retain the target revenue margin, but the draft also presents these discounted scenarios as part of the main comparison without explicitly labeling them as discounted-only outcomes or clarifying that the target margin is defined on the undiscounted recommended price.
findings.requestedChange: Revise the summary to explicitly distinguish target-margin pricing from post-discount realized margin, and state that discounted scenarios are a stress test of price concessions rather than target-margin-achievement cases.

findings.issue: The assumption references a validity window for the demonstration fixtures, but the objective only requires the analysis as of 2026-10-24 and does not ask for a forward-validity claim. This creates an unsupported implied availability window beyond the as-of date.
findings.requestedChange: Either remove the forward-validity statement or qualify it as a fixture-specific metadata field that is not a claim of business availability beyond the as-of date.

findings.issue: The discounted 20% scenario is shown with a realized revenue margin of 12.23%, but the draft does not explicitly state the calculation basis for the discounted margin in the scenario entry itself, which can make the negative impact of discounting easy to misread as a target-margin miss in the underlying pricing formula.
findings.requestedChange: Add an explicit field or note in each discounted scenario clarifying that the displayed revenueMargin is post-discount realized margin on charged price, not the original targetRevenueMargin.

findings.issue: The limitation says the rule is synthetic and not Shopee, which is valid, but the draft elsewhere names the applied rule as 'demo-direct' without a clear validity label on the scenario-level rule itself. That makes the source/validity labeling slightly inconsistent across the document.
findings.requestedChange: Add or harmonize a scenario-level validity label for appliedRule and ruleId so every scenario clearly states the rule is a synthetic demonstration fixture.
